THE ULTIMATE VIRTUAL MANUFACTURING SPACE

ANYWHERE, ANYTIME ANY TECHNOLOGY

Enables leveraging all available technologies and materials, across a global network of industrial 3D printers – helping on-location production JIT (Just-in-time) to significantly reduce shipping and logistics costs.

IP PROTECTED WITH FULL TRACEABILITY

Trusted by top tier manufacturers to manage and protect IP shared with vendors during design and production using sophisticated blockchain and encryption technologies.

Read more

QUICK ROI WITH NO CAPEX

Novel SaaS platform for industrial 3D printers takes Additive Manufacturing to an unprecedented global scale, enabling manufacturers worldwide reap all the benefits without the capital investment and maintenance costs – for quickest ROI possible.

Read more

MAINTAIN END TO END CONTROL OVER THE PRODUCTION PROCESS

Assembrix VMS allows manufactures to remotely manage the entire Additive Manufacturing digital thread in a fully automated and self-controlled process. Optimization of the 3D printers supply chain, whether distributed or aggregated, keeps resources and costs to a minimum.

SECURE YOUR WAY INTO THE FUTURE OF DISTRIBUTED ADDITIVE MANUFACTURING

Assembrix VMS applies highest security standards to enable remote manufacturing while maintaining complete ownership and control of the IP throughout the entire automated printing process. A real-time data feed keeps customers updated on the printing status, while advanced blockchain-based encryption ensures IP protection.
